Void Runner

0

White platforms hang over a red void that never ends. Chain jumps, wall runs, rolls and bounce pads to build speed. Fall and your run is over.

W A S D
Run. Hold Shift to sprint.
Space
Jump. Landings turn into rolls.
C
Slide under low beams while sprinting, or crouch under them while moving slowly.
Mouse
Look around. Q / E also turns the view.
Walls
Jump at a side wall to run along it for 1.5 s.
Gaps
Platform spacing changes from jump to jump. Wider gaps have launch pads, wall runs, rope swings or climbable towers to help you cross.
Ramps
Ramps make you slide automatically. Climb the wall-block towers, then jump down to keep racing. The three paths change height order throughout the run; find the red crossing pads to change path.
Rope
Some gaps are too wide to jump. Jump at the hanging rope to grab it, hold W to pump forward, and A / D to sway left and right. Press Space with a direction held to leap that way.
Paths
Three routes meet at junction decks as you progress. Jump across obstacle-marked stepping plots between routes, or use the marked crossing pads to change paths. A switch is worth bonus points.
Pads
Red pads launch you. Rolls and wall runs raise your top speed.
V
Switch first / third person.
N
Toggle the background music. Use the music control to adjust its volume.

Adjust how quickly the camera moves with your mouse.
